# Open Agent

> AI Automation & Digital Marketing Agency for small businesses in Pakistan and the United States. Founded by Abeer Nasir, based in Karachi, Pakistan.

Open Agent helps small businesses grow with Meta & Google Ads, social media management, AI agents, AI websites, AI automation, and digital marketing — explained in plain English, no jargon. Prices start from PKR 15,000.

## Key facts

- Founder: Abeer Nasir (Generative AI Specialist, AI Agent Developer, Digital Marketing Specialist)
- Location: Karachi, Pakistan
- Serves: small businesses in Pakistan and the United States
- Free first call, no long contracts, small budgets welcome, 3-day money-back guarantee
- Offer: 25% OFF all services until Aug 14, 2026
- Contact: WhatsApp +923703159642 · Email abeerinfo5566@gmail.com
